summary: CCC wood-frame lookout dated 1938-39 on the Medicine Lake refuge's Homestead Lake tract; listed as removed, and sources disagree on its height.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

access.note: On refuge land with public roads and a public auto tour. No source describes access to the Homestead site itself.

events.note: Listing dates the CCC work to 1938-39 and gives a 30-foot wood frame tower; 1938 is the start of that range.

notes_for_editor: Height conflict: Forest Lookouts gives a 30-foot wood frame tower for the 1938-39 CCC work; the Montana History Portal Homestead Lake entry gives 100 feet for a CCC lookout tower at the lake. Status 'gone' is supported by the 'Removed' line on the Forest Lookouts page, which gives no removal year. The record's point (48.48357, -104.35426) is a different point from firelookout.com's standing 'Medicine Lake (USFWS)' steel tower (48.48298, -104.45070), which the FFLA photo post may be describing as moved to the refuge. The sources do not show whether they are the same structure, so an editor may want to check for a duplicate or link between the two records. No source gives staffing, fires or any remains at the Homestead site. The 'built' year 1938 is the first year of the sources' 1938-39 range.
